_approach: 'Beat de faixa' names the accelerated 150 BPM funk lane Rennan da Penha and the Baile da Gaiola scene pushed from 2014, moving the tamborzão out of the 130 pocket into a harder, more frenetic 140-155 range. This groove keeps the tamborzão's kick-1&3/clap-2&4 skeleton but straightens the swing and hardens the kick and clap so the pattern reads as driving rather than bouncy at the higher tempo. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
